items.why: Chip and AI names slid after a hot inflation report put another Fed rate hike back in play; Motley Fool also flagged memory chip stocks declining today.
AI-related stocks dropped with the broader market on the hot inflation data; 24/7 Wall St noted Burry is betting against chip stocks.
Mega cap tech sold off as hot inflation data put another Fed rate hike back in play, per 24/7 Wall St.
Fear gauge spiking as AP reports stocks are dropping toward their worst day since July on worsening inflation.

market_note: S&P futures down 1.2%, Nasdaq futures down 2.0%, VIX up 10.9%.
summary: Stocks slid Wednesday after a hot inflation report revived talk of another Fed rate hike, with AI and chip names leading the decline.
